text: こども　なのに…　なかなかの　つかいて　だな

structure.jp: なかなかの　つかいて　だな

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', with a feeling of surprise. After a thing word it needs な in front. こども　なのに = 'even though you're a kid'.

patterns.name: なかなかの〜
patterns.span: なかなかの　つかいて
patterns.explanation: なかなかの before a thing means 'quite a', said with some admiration. なかなかの　つかいて = 'quite a skilled Trainer'.
